events.text: Hsu began his political career in the Kuomintang as a member of the Taiwan Provincial Assembly.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Hsu began his political career in the Kuomintang as a member of the Taiwan Provincial Assembly from 1973 to 1977

events.text: Hsu's membership in the Taiwan Provincial Assembly ended.
events.subject: self

events.text: Hsu was expelled from the Kuomintang.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was expelled from the Kuomintang

events.text: Hsu broke ranks in 1977 when he ran and won as an independent in the election for Magistrate of Taoyuan County.
